summary: Renewal check-in focused on Panorama's interest in upgrading to a larger Dedicated capacity, adding eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 regions, and extending contract term with a capacity commit. Security asked about SOC2, KMS, audit logs and private/on-prem options. Redwood to run benchmarks in eu-west-1, share pricing tiers, and provide compliance docs. Pilot option discussed to de-risk a longer commit.
transcript:
Header: 2026-10-02 15:00 PDT - Duration ~42 minutes
Attendees: Sofia Martinez (Redwood AE), Daniel Cho (Redwood SE), Lena Ortiz (Redwood CSM); Aisha Khan (Panorama Head of MLOps), Marcus Lee (VP Eng), Priya Patel (Security), Jared Nguyen (Infra)

[00:00] Sofia: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, we have about 40 minutes, agenda - 1 renewal options, capacity upgrade, region expansion. Daniel will walk the benchmark plan.
[00:18] Aisha: Main thing - 1 we're seeing growth and want to upgrade from D4 to D8 dedicated pool and add eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 for EMEA/APAC latency. Also curious pricing differences 12 vs 24 month commit.
[00:34] Daniel: Clarify D8 - 1 doubling GPU count or larger instance types?
[00:45] Marcus: Aim for ~2x throughput, larger instance type, predictable cost for budgeting - 1 committed monthly throughput preferred.
[00:58] Priya: Security questions - 1 KMS integration, key rotation, audit logs retention, and private/on-prem for PHI.
[01:12] Sofia: We'll send SOC2 and KMS docs. Private deploy supported but need to scope network/data flow; Daniel will follow up.
[01:28] Daniel: Benchmark plan - 1 2-hour run in eu-west-1 using top 3 prompt sets to measure p99 and throughput under real batching. We'll provision test cluster mirroring D8.
[01:45] Jared: Lead time to provision? Do we provide model artifacts or use Redwood-hosted variants?
[01:56] Daniel: 3-5 business days after provisioning; we can pull artifacts via secure transfer or run Redwood-hosted variants.
[02:12] Marcus: Expected p99 delta hosted -> dedicated? Tail latency is critical.
[02:24] Daniel: Dedicated with reserved capacity tightens p99 typically 10-25% improvement depending on sequence length and batching; model variance applies.
[02:40] Aisha: Cost? Dedicated predictability vs per-token cost for 12 vs 24 months?
[02:51] Sofia: We'll send pricing matrix; 24-month and larger commits get steeper discounts and reserved buffer for burst.
[03:06] Priya: Audit log retention configurable? We need 7 years.
[03:14] Daniel: Retention configurable; long-term archiving to your S3 supported. Air-gapped can have local log shipping.
[03:27] Priya: Encryption at rest BYOK?
[03:34] Sofia: Both Redwood-managed and BYOK supported for Private and Dedicated with VPC.
[03:44] Marcus: VPC peering keeps traffic private?
[03:52] Daniel: Yes, VPC peering and private links supported; we'll run config with your network team.
[04:05] Aisha: Model parity across regions?
[04:18] Daniel: We aim for parity; pin model versions and quantization profiles to reduce variance.
[04:33] Lena: Redwood Optimize can suggest quantization and batching to reduce cost while keeping quality.
[04:45] Marcus: Benchmarks vs current prod baseline to ensure no quality loss?
[04:56] Daniel: We'll run side-by-side on your baseline prompts and measure quality and token counts.
[05:12] Aisha: Failover behavior if eu-west overloaded? Route to cheaper region or hosted?
[05:24] Sofia: Smart routing supports policy-based fallback to compatible variants or hosted tier; can set region priority by latency or cost.
[05:36] Priya: Legal - 1 data residency clauses for extended term?
[05:46] Sofia: Residency constraints can be added to contract; Private is customer-managed.
[05:58] Marcus: Fixed unit price for tokens if we commit 24 months and add two regions?
[06:08] Sofia: We can propose fixed per-token tiers with throughput commit; will include scenarios.
[06:18] Aisha: Timeline - 1 want capacity by Nov 15 for peak loads; feasible?
[06:29] Daniel: With signed commit and confirmed capacity, Nov 15 is tight but doable; need traffic profile and artifacts within 2 weeks.
[06:44] Jared: We'll try to deliver artifacts within 10 business days.
[06:50] Sofia: Recap action items.
[07:03] Aisha: SLA delta hosted vs dedicated?
[07:09] Lena: Dedicated has SLA-backed uptime and tighter latency commitments; hosted is best-effort. We'll include SLA matrix.
[07:22] Marcus: Setup fees for new regions?
[07:28] Sofia: One-time provisioning fee typical for new Dedicated regions; numbers in pricing sheet.
[07:37] Priya: Private deployment licensing model?
[07:46] Sofia: Private is licensed separately (platform fee + support tier), on-prem air-gapped requires implementation engagement.
[07:59] Daniel: For long-context workloads tune KV cache and optimized kernels; affects throughput/cost.
[08:13] Marcus: Short chat + longer summarization mix - 1 route by workload to different pools; autoscale policies manage cost.
[08:35] Aisha: Can we test failover and routing in benchmark?
[08:41] Daniel: Yes, we can simulate failover.
[08:47] Sofia: Competitors?
[08:54] Marcus: Evaluating Anthropic (model quality) and ModelServe Inc (infra cost). We care about observability and predictable economics.
[09:06] Sofia: We'll include Console screenshots and cost breakdowns.
[09:17] Priya: Example audit log format?
[09:24] Daniel: We'll attach sample log extract and schema.
[09:28] Aisha: Anything else?
[09:31] Marcus: Example contract addendum for region/capacity commit please.
[09:39] Sofia: We'll draft addendum.
[09:44] Lena: Suggest pilot: 6-week dedicated trial with limited commit to validate p99 and cost before 24-month commit.
[09:57] Marcus: Likes the pilot idea.
[10:05] Aisha: Agreed.
[10:09] Sofia: Recap: Sofia sends pricing + SOC2/KMS docs; Daniel provisions eu-west-1 test cluster; Panorama provides prompts/traffic profile; Redwood drafts pilot plan and contract addendum.
[10:22] Jared: Timeline: prompts/artifacts by Oct 6, legal review addendum by Oct 12.
[10:30] Sofia: Target benchmark week of Oct 12.
[10:37] Priya: Include VPC peering checklist for infra team.
[10:44] Daniel: Will include checklist.
[10:51] Aisha: Thanks everyone.
[10:53] Sofia: Thanks, follow up on next steps.
[11:00] (meeting ends)

Notes: occasional transcription mis-heard 'D8' as 'dee eight' and 'KMS' rendered as 'K M S' in spots.
